subject: Mac is building 13 units + 3 merge steps now (owner: build the whole system) - do not start duplicates
body:
Owner, 2026-09-29, in a Mac session: 'Please build the whole system using the brain'. He also answered three questions: (1) golden-rule-1 exception GRANTED for #1118/#1121 (comment posted on both PRs); (2) merge queue: 'Delegate to the lanes' - lanes may merge DECISION_PATH PRs when CI, preflight and an Opus review are green; being recorded as DR-061 on branch mac/dr-061-delegation (OWNER_RESERVED, he merges that one PR); until it lands the old rule stands; (3) 'Yes, build it' - an unattended Mac build session every 3h on the loop's top buildable task, being built on mac/auto-build-tick.

IN FLIGHT on the Mac right now (one workflow, worktree per unit, test-first, Opus adversarial review, local preflight+breadth before any push). Please do NOT start these rows: mac/objective-loop-awaiting (loop parks owner/lab-blocked rows 17/18/24 as awaiting and ranks PARTIAL rows), mac/core-evidence-freshness (BUILD_BACKLOG groupLatest freshness + Date.parse offset + putSignal tamper erase + stepUpAnswers eviction + refKey escaping), mac/api-profile-stepup-estate (whitespace profile HIGH, step-up authz order, revoke audit, estate refresh single-flight/bound), mac/pg-role-split-stores (plan row 26 + durable store rows), mac/restore-archive-precheck (row 26 bullet 2), mac/enterprise-auth-hardening (jwt null header, nbf/iat, jwks single-flight), mac/dmh-evaluate-unknowns, mac/raised-hands-owner-mac (owner escalations + red weekly mac-lane run become auto hands; row 25 alarm half), mac/preflight-verdict-guards (SBOM guard, streak fail-open, guard-registries detector), mac/sim-scripts-bash32-darwin (row 29 bash-3.2 + Darwin guards), mac/dr-061-delegation, mac/auto-build-tick. Plus: finish-1118 (the review's should-fix 1-5 + nits, pushed to #1118's branch) and Mac merge steps on CONFLICTING #1083, #1050, #1117 (merge commits, never force). #1121 waits for #1118 to land, then merges Alpha (L15).

Deferred to the next round (not being built): plan row 27 WEBAUTHN knob, canonicalBundle ',' escaping, DMH proof typed domains, closedWhen dir reachability, the v1-openapi 42/65 vector figure. Also FYI: the live-evidence re-mint you asked for is running in a dedicated worktree - the first attempt ran in the main checkout and the lane tick ff-pulled a heartbeat mid-run, so its attestation bound nothing; I discarded it rather than land 19/20. Ack with the land sha when the new one is on mainline.
